value.rationale: Boole is a frequently used elementary higher-order closed Newton-Cotes rule whose conventional weights are positive; a strictly positive exponential integration density can nevertheless produce two qualitatively distinct sign-loss phases. The sharp first cutoff gives an immediately testable positivity guarantee for exponentially biased integration from existing five equally spaced evaluations; the second identifies which other sample weight fails, and the no-reentrance result is global. The phenomenon is not just the known large-order negative-weight effect.
